description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimExpenseAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing claim expenses within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim expenses, as well as associated validation rules and detailed OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseAPI
classes.description: API class for managing claim expenses including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expenses with OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim expenses associated with a specific claim request, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the creation of a new claim expense.

methods.name: setClaimExpense
methods.description: Populates a ClaimExpense entity with request parameters, handling validation and persistence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing claim expenses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes one or more claim expenses associated with a specific claim request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific claim expense by its ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single claim expense.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim expense with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a claim expense.
